name: Artequest Art Gallery
description:
Artequest Art Gallery (AAG) the famous art gallery in South Asia has established in 2010 at prime location in Mumbai, India. It has grown with a view to promote Modern Art and Contemporary Art. The gallery relentlessly involved in the recognition and promotion of emerging Artists, creating an awareness of art amongst old and new collectors by showcasing good quality art works and providing a platform for interaction between artists and Art collectors.

Artequest goes through a rigorous selection process and bringing only authentic & original paintings for sale. Our Collection includes Tyeb Mehta, Jamini Roy, S.H Raza, F.N.Souza, M. F. Husain, Laxma Goud, ThotaVaikuntam, Anjolie Ela Menon and so many more well-known & young artists.

featured_reviews.name: Philip Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
In the ‘Maximum City’ of Mumbai, Artequest gallery offers a unique experience of serene beauty of art. It boasts of amazing collection of both ‘Masters’ and other renowned artists spanning the length and breadth of our country.

It has wide range of paintings, sculptors, lithographs, sketches and drawings. Mumbai has many renowned art galleries and Artequest shines as one of the ‘must see’ galleries in the city.
Artequest had displayed its works in many countries across the globe and attracted many international connoisseurs of art.

The gallery offers serene ambience where one can immerse in artistic poetry. Its location is easy to find on google maps, and it has ample parking space too.  It’s not to be missed if you are living in Mumbai or travelling to this wonderful city.

featured_reviews.name: Sky & Patty Williamson
featured_reviews.review_text: I had the good fortune of finding Natesan’s beautiful collection a few years ago and was delighted to return on my recent visit to Mumbai in March 2026.  The showroom is two levels, a beautifully curated display of original antiquities for viewing on the first floor and an equally beautiful and intriguing display of finest quality reproductions and non antique vintage pieces available for purchase on the second floor.  The collection was quite diverse with brass and bronze hindu statues, wood carved pieces, and artwork - stunning.  A wide range of sizes and pricepoints are also available and at good value given the very high quality of the pieces.  I had a wonderful discussion of the various pieces with Pushpa who was very charming and extremely knowledgeable about the history and artistic styles.  This is a no pressure environment and i would have viewed the visit alone as a highpoint, though i was thrilled to take home a beautiful Kerala mural.  Pushpa was very helpful in talking through the transport options and it was a seamless and easy transaction.  Definitely make a visit to Natesan’s a priority on your next Mumbai visit.  Cheers! Patty
